mapping.draft_py:
# Bone to Ash: "Counter target creature spell." (the Anticognition/Miscast shape with one type),
# then the compiler's "Draw a card." as the second step of the instant's Seq.
counter = A(Verb.COUNTER_SPELL, {
    'target': Selector(
        count=QConst(value=1),
        mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
        filter=FAnd(children=(
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.STACK_KIND_EQ, string_value='SPELL'),
        )),
        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.STACK, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
    ),
})
draw = compiled[0].effect
abilities = [SpellAbility(kind=SpellKind.INSTANT, effect=Seq(steps=(counter, draw)))]
